name: trips
description: A docked Trips pane for your desktop Claude Code sessions (who waits on you, the last 24 hours, older trips with search), plus a local interstitial journal: one line per task switch, what was done and what comes next, with day closes and week, month and year summaries.

actOnOtherSessions.title: Act on other sessions
actOnOtherSessions.description: Show Reply and Done on sessions that wait on you, so you can answer or clear them from the Trips pane. Off: Trips only reads and opens sessions.

journalDir.title: Journal folder
journalDir.description: Where the journal keeps its files. A leading ~ is your home folder.
